'''Jonathan Squire''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Squire was present in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Festival of Love]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. He started writing a letter to the woman he loved and a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by Dr. [[Schill]] assisted him in finishing the letter.
